name: Richmond YouthWORKS Work Experience Program (WEX)
what_you_do: You get a paid internship of up to 100 hours. It is with local businesses, government or nonprofits. You also get workshops and career coaching.
who_can_apply: Richmond youth ages 16 to 21. Must attend required workshops and training to be guaranteed an internship.
pay_detail: Paid internship; the hourly rate is not stated on the page
deadline_text: Applications are closed as of Nov 2, 2026. The form says to check back in January 2027.
how_to_apply: The online form linked on the city page is closed for now. Check back in January 2027. After you apply, the team contacts you for an intake. Phone (510) 412-2044.
notes: The page refers to Richmond youth but does not spell out a residency rule. Ask about the hourly wage and your start date at intake.
